messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager SEV2 - metering token-count drift in eu-west-1 detected. Alert MTR-2026-1834. Possible customer-visible overage flags.
maya: taking this. pinging @rishi for oncall handoff.
rishi: oncall here, taking lead. more details?
leah: noticing spike in overage emails starting ~2026-03-20T02:11Z. Some customers saw >2x flags. Investigating counts vs emitted.
carlos: Support is getting DMs from a few customers. Need list who got overage emails so CS can reach out.
emma: I can draft a proactive note if we confirm scope. sharing case template.
rishi: quick triage: running aggregation query on prod-agg:
```
SELECT source, sum(tokens_emitted) as emitted, sum(tokens_aggregated) as agg
FROM metering.events
WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND hour >= '2026-03-20T02'
GROUP BY source;
```
rishi: result: emitted=1,242,918; agg=1,018,256 -> ~22% under-aggregation. logs show TTL evictions on kv-prefix cache around 02:08Z.
leah: that explains drift — aggregator missed prefixes so later emits double-counted when reprocessed? :thinking_face:
billing-bot: Shadow-charge suppression toggled off in last deploy at 02:05Z by deploy-1234.
maya: can we roll back that change? it's risky but might stop customer emails.
rishi: propose immediate mitigations:
• pause overage email worker (billing-emails) -> action maya
• enable temporary suppress_overage flag in billing pipeline -> action leah
• route new ingestion to dedupe path -> action eng-sre team
maya: pausing billing-emails now: `kubectl scale deployment billing-emails -n billing --replicas=0` -> done :white_check_mark:
leah: patching billing pipeline config -> `suppress_overage=true` applying to prod/billing-config -> applied :white_check_mark:
carlos: thanks — CS holding outbound messages. please share list when available.
rishi: opened temporary alert: MTR-2026-1834-rollback if kv-evictions stop for 15m. Added runbook link: https://redwood.runbooks/metering-drift
maya: digging into KV TTL change: found commit d4c3b2 reverted default ttl from 24h -> 1h in recent rollout. tagging @eng-oncall for rollback.
eng-oncall: scheduling a hotfix rollback to restore TTL to 24h, rolling to eu-west-1 now. ETA 8m.
incident-bot: Deploy bot: rollbacks/rollout-432 started by eng-oncall. CI checks passing.
rishi: monitoring aggregate catch-up. running recon query every 2m.
leah: preparing customer impact list: 14 accounts flagged, magnitude small but visible. will hand to CS for outreach once recon done.
emma: I'll standby and send template once we confirm final scope. thanks team :pray:
maya: handing off to overnight oncall @rishi at 03:00Z. will compile timeline + next steps for postmortem.
rishi: ack handoff. logging in incident tracker MTR-2026-1834. next steps: postmortem, fix release, add e2e to catch kv-ttl regressions.
incident-bot: Incident status -> Mitigated (partial). last update 1834567600.
